name: Form Engine Room
implementation_notes: Engine Room Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from engineRoomRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Storage Tank Detail (screen-076's mobile precedent)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormStorageTankView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan/status terisi) validated at FE + repo level (engineRoomRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws EngineRoomDetailRequiredError) -- this station has 27 non-time_slot columns, the LARGEST of any station in this project, all of which participate in the 'filled' check (no identifying/context columns to exclude)

The 2 enum status columns (Diesel Gen 1 Status, Diesel Gen 2 Status: Run/Standby/Off) are each rendered as a native <select> dropdown with a '-- Pilih --' empty option, styled with the existing .native-select CSS class; local SQLite has no CHECK constraint so no empty-string coercion is required in this repo (unlike the web backend, see screen-097/117)
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Effluent Plant: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. steam-inlet-pressure-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide, same defensive pattern as FormStorageTankView.vue

Field order in the grid & template mirrors the migration column order exactly: Steam Turbine (6 fields) -> Diesel Gen 1 (5) -> Diesel Gen 2 (5) -> Electrical Sync (4) -> Air Compressor/Battery/Fuel/Energy (4) -> Action Taken/Findings (2) = 27 total

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (FormEngineRoomView.spec.ts, 20 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full Simpan/Pause/Clear/Back flow in a live dev server.
